lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a pair of September 30 sessions on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific — Town Council convenes a special appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that was challenged after P&Z approved it in July, while HARC holds a dedicated special meeting to review three separate Preliminary Large-Scale applications covering the project's building clusters. Alongside that, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a consequential choice on September 28: whether to pursue federally funded or locally led project delivery — federal dollars versus local control. P&Z also holds a work session September 24 on an early-stage employee housing proposal tied to the school district.

notable.stake: Early look at school-district employee housing proposal near middle-high school.
